lines: Gosha Academy. A school in Gosha Village and an institution for training young Taimanin.
Prospective Taimanin had gathered in the training facility that had been built beneath the school grounds. Today was the day of the practical exam.
As one would expect of a school for Taimanin, during the exam period, in addition to general subjects such as Japanese and mathematics, a practical exam was also conducted.
(As someone with no Ninja Art, I've always held back tears during these practical exams... But this time is going to be different.)
The test this time was a squad battle. In other words, we would fight as a team.
(I'm confident in my leadership. And I've already teamed up several times with Hebiko and Shikanosuke in actual battles.)
(The two of them are used to my commands. That means we have an overwhelming advantage, and even getting top marks wouldn't be a pipe dream.)
(And if we can do that, I can negotiate with Tokiko for more allowance!)
ーThat's what I had thought, but...
I let out an involuntary shout and was scolded by Murasaki-sensei.
(I mean... I mean I didn't expect both Hebiko and Shikanosuke to be on other teams...)
My team didn't include Hebiko and Shikanosuke, and my two teammates were students I had never worked with before. How could I not scream?
The losing team will have to take an additional exam. Alright, separate into teams!
Ugh... my plans to get a bigger allowance...
Hey, Fuma! Don't be disappointed that I'm not with you!
It is what it is. Just do your best, Fuma-chan.
Hrrmm... Judging by your reaction, you two are on the same team?
Me!!! Isn't that too bad, lonesome Fuma!
Yukikaze was known as the "Lightning Taimanin" and was capable enough to already go on actual combat missions.
It's a shame for Fuma-chan, but... jackpot! To be teaming up with Yukikaze-chan... here comes that top score!
Being on Yukikaze's team is almost like we've already won! I feel bad for you though, Fuma!
Ehehe... an exam is an exam♪
Damn it! Get lost! From this day forth, you're all enemies!
However, there was no way to change what had been decided. I reluctantly moved to my team's location.
Hm? Gimme a break, I'm with the silver spoon kid!?
A red-haired girl stared at me with her eyes wide open.
What's with the long face? Well, let's do this!
Kamimura Maika was one of my classmates and a Fire Art user.
With their Fire Jutsu, Fire Art users could burn their enemies with roaring flames. It was a flashy, easy to understand, and celebrated Ninja Art.
And among the Fire Art users, she was considered an outstanding candidate to carry the future of the Fire Art Taimanin.
(If we're only talking about firepower, she's as good as Yukikaze, butー)
Listen up, Fuma! I'm fine on my own. If ya get in my way, I'll burn ya to a crisp, got it!?
(Eeeeeep... she doesn't give a shiiiit about working as a team...)
The problem was her personality. After all, she was feared as the biggest delinquent in the whole school.
My teammates are... Don't tell me it's you two?
I never thought I'd be paired with two hoodlums...
It was Yubashiri Hayate, the daughter of the prestigious Yubashiri Clan.
Although still young, she was an excellent archer, but she was also known for being overly serious and stubborn, which made her the exact opposite of the delinquent Maika.
Alright, both of you stay out of my way.
Huh? Wha'dya just say, ya useless spoiled princess?!
I said if you stay out of my way, I'll make sure you get a good grade.
Huuh? I'll blow your ass up!!
You delinquent. How about I shoot you in that big mouth of yours!?
(Wooooow...!!! These girls reeeeally don't want to work as a team!)
Did you separate into teams? Representatives, come and get the match list! The number next to yours will be your opponent.
Leaving the two of them to their bickering, I received the match list from Murasaki-sensei.
Here, our team's opponent is blank though...?
On the printout I had been handed, the space for our team's opponent was the only spot that was blank.
Yes, that's because there's one team left over if you split into teams of three.
Murasaki-sensei's expression softened ever so slightly.
Asagi-sama☆ ...No, er... the headmistress will be your opponent.
Of course you'd literally be defeated in an instant if she took it seriously.
So as a handicap, the headmistress will stand alone against you three.
The Almighty Taimanin will be your opponent. I'm so jeal... I mean, you better be grateful.
I had witnessed Headmistress Asagi's strength during Gaiza's attack.
Even though there were three of us and we were all capable, we were still just students.
(And we have zero teamwork. It's absolutely impossible...)
Woohoo!!! We're gonna fight against the headmistress!? I'm gettin' fired up!!!
Y-You sure are motivated... H-Hey! Let's have a strategy meeting!!
The other teams knew their opponents and also had begun to discuss their strategies.
Who gives a rat's ass about that! Stay outta my way, both of ya!
I can't let a delinquent like you have the honor of fighting Headmistress Asagi.
As I held my head in my handsー
I heard footsteps, and Headmistress Asagi appeared, dressed in her Taima-Suit.
Why am I separated from Hebiko and Shikanosuke? All the other teams are people that always work together...
Hehe. That's because you're the captain of the Independent Commando Unit.
Everyone else generally teams up with other Taimanin in actual combat. But not in your case.
There are times where you need to hire mercenaries from shady cities or where you need to work with people who were your enemies just yesterday. Do you understand?
Not only had I been separated from Hebiko and Shikanosuke, but I also had been paired with Maika and Hayate, who were complete opposites of each other in terms of personality.
(Alright... I guess then we'll just have to do it. I'll give it my all...!)
A leadership style that brings out the best in everyone, no matter their personality or strengths.
(I should be able to do thatー!!)
